historical_events.name: The Great Rebellion
historical_events.date: Approximately 200-300 years before present; exact year unresolved
historical_events.description: Six Great Houses united against the dragon-riding dynasty to restore Great House independence and destroy dragon-riding supremacy. The war lasted a few years and was devastating.

historical_events.name: Fall of the Dragon-Riding Dynasty
historical_events.description: The Imperial Seat fell and nearly the entire ruling family was killed. The dragon-riding dynasty lost approximately four centuries of rule.

historical_events.name: Kharadorn Occupation of Dragonstone
historical_events.description: The dwarven main branch claimed and occupied Dragonstone, the former ancestral stronghold of the fallen dragon-riding dynasty. Khar-Dum remained the Kharadorns' ancestral homeland.

historical_events.name: Post-Rebellion Kharadorn Rule
historical_events.date: Immediate aftermath through more than a century after the rebellion
historical_events.description: The same dwarven leader who directed the rebellion held power for more than a century and remained in authority until his death.

historical_events.name: Kharadorn Succession Crisis
historical_events.date: After the death of the post-Rebellion dwarven leader; exact date unresolved
historical_events.description: The successor inherited dwarven authority, but a succession crisis led to a confrontation over the Imperial Seat.

historical_events.name: Installation of the Calderan Compromise Monarch
historical_events.date: After the succession crisis; exact date unresolved
historical_events.description: The dwarven successor threatened war unless a human was placed on the Imperial Seat. The head of House Calderan, one of the original six rebel houses, was installed as compromise monarch. His claim is legitimate and hereditary, while the precise sources of political constraint remain unresolved.

boundaries: The original name of the fallen dragon-riding dynasty remains unresolved.
Dragonstone remains a provisional working place-name; Khar-Dum is the Kharadorns' ancestral homeland.
The precise forces and relationships constraining King Aldric Calderan remain unresolved.
Do not assume a single power controls the monarch.
The ultimate fate of dragons that escaped the rebellion remains unknown.
Which accounts of the rebellion are documented, disputed, suppressed, or deliberately falsified remains unresolved.
